name: Norrlie
summary: A Scandinavian furniture shop with a scroll film of a chair assembling from dawn to dusk
about: A complete online store for a small furniture workshop. The home page is a pinned, scroll-driven film: an exploded oak chair joins piece by piece while daylight moves through the room from dawn to dusk, followed by a forest-to-floor craft timeline and three furnished rooms with clickable hotspots. The shop has filters, sort and search, finish and size pickers that repaint the drawing, a PKR bag with promo codes and a validated checkout.
how: Scroll the home page to play the film: legs, rails, seat and back arrive while the light shifts; Skip film jumps past it.
Scroll on to watch the craft timeline draw itself, then switch rooms with the tabs and open a dot to try a finish and add the piece to your bag.
Open the shop and filter by category, finish, size, price or sale, then sort or search.
On a piece, choose a finish (a new coat wipes across the drawing), a size and a quantity, then Add to bag: a plank is planed, shavings curl off and a parcel flies to the bag.
In the bag, change quantities, remove pieces and try the demo codes NORR10 or FREEHAUL.
Checkout validates your details, shows card fields when you pick card, and ends on a thank-you page with a delivery van.
